snippet.title: Game Boy Longplay [300] Paperboy 2
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Reinc

Paperboy 2 was released in 1991 - 1992 for the Amiga, Amstrad CPC, Atari ST, MS-DOS, Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega Mega Drive/Genesis, NES, SNES, and ZX Spectrum. While Paperboy debuted in arcades and was subsequently ported to home systems, this game was only released for consumer systems. 

The game is much like the original: the player controls a paperboy (or papergirl) who must navigate a bizarre series of obstacles, such as tires rolling down a driveway while a car is being repaired, or strange houses like a haunted house, while trying to deliver the morning paper to various customers on a street (though unlike its predecessor, papers had to be delivered to houses on both sides of the street).

There are many different news headlines you can get. Hopefully, I was able to show all of them throughout playthroughs of all the ports I recorded.

The Game Boy version is definitely the worst one, with very limited vision and little to no time to react, and no space to throw papers in advance. -
